body_markdown:
*Offering provides accredited investors access to royalty income from more than 200 producing oil and natural gas wells across the Permian Basin and Haynesville Shale*


DALLAS, Oct. 6, 2026 /PRNewswire/ —[NexPoint](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4790092-1&h=3803840284&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.nexpoint.com%2F&a=NexPoint) , a multibillion-dollar alternative investment firm, today announced the launch of[NexPoint Energy DST](https://www.nexpoint.com/dsts-1031-exchanges/energy-dst/) (the “Offering”), a[Delaware statutory trust](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4790092-1&h=853433293&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.nexpoint.com%2Fdsts-1031-exchange%2F&a=Delaware+statutory+trust) (“DST”) offering comprised of oil and natural gas mineral rights across two of the most prolific energy-producing regions in North America: the Permian Basin in Texas and the Haynesville Shale in Louisiana. The Offering marks NexPoint’s first energy DST and brings mineral rights, a new sector for the DST product, to the firm’s tax-advantaged investment platform.


The portfolio includes approximately 1,277 net royalty acres with interests in more than 200 producing oil and natural gas wells, along with more than 300 undrilled locations. Approximately 90% of the portfolio is associated with natural gas production from the Haynesville Shale, with the remaining 10% associated with oil from the Permian Basin. The Offering is sized at $18,844,000 and requires a minimum investment of $100,000. It is available only to accredited investors, and the DST structure provides the potential to involve investors looking to complete 1031 exchanges.


Unlike traditional direct energy investments, the DST owns mineral rights and receives royalty income derived from the sale of oil and natural gas produced from the properties. Drilling, field operations, production, and marketing are managed by a group of established oil and gas operators. This structure allows investors to potentially participate in production revenue and future development activity without direct responsibility for drilling costs or day-to-day operations.1


“For years, NexPoint has used the DST structure to give investors access to specialized sectors they could not easily reach on their own, and mineral rights are a natural next step,” said Luke Blackwell, President of NexPoint’s energy investment platform. “This portfolio combines existing production, identified reserves, and a deep bench of experienced operators in the Permian and the Haynesville. We believe it offers investors a differentiated way to participate in one of the world’s most essential industries through a royalty-based, income-oriented structure.”


The Offering’s acreage sits in two of the nation’s leading energy basins. According to the U.S. Energy Information Administration, the Permian Basin produced approximately 6.6 million barrels of crude oil per day in 2025, accounting for nearly half of total U.S. oil production. The Haynesville Shale, which spans Louisiana and East Texas, produced approximately 14.9 billion cubic feet of natural gas per day in 2025, and its proximity to Gulf Coast liquefied natural gas (LNG) export facilities positions it as an important source of supply for growing domestic and global demand.


NexPoint has significant experience in the DST space, having brought 36 DST programs to market since 2016 and delivered over $3.2 billion2 in gross real estate through DSTs. The firm has launched offerings in a range of both niche and core real estate sectors including self-storage, small bay industrial, life sciences, multifamily, hospitality, and marinas. NexPoint has also historically invested in the oil and gas sector across its corporate balance sheet, affiliated ownership structures, and personal capital commitments from NexPoint management. The firm is now pairing this experience with its established DST platform.


**About NexPoint**


NexPoint is a multibillion-dollar investment firm based in Dallas, Texas. The firm is structured around three major business areas:[real estate](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4790092-1&h=481461097&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.nexpoint.com%2Four-businesses%2Freal-estate%2F&a=real+estate) ,[corporate credit and equities](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4790092-1&h=1594525141&u=https%3A%2F%2Fedge.prnewswire.com%2Fc%2Flink%2F%3Ft%3D0%26l%3Den%26o%3D4530920-1%26h%3D1817686801%26u%3Dhttps%253A%252F%252Fwww.nexpoint.com%252Four-businesses%252Fcorporate-credit-equities%252F%26a%3Dcorporate%2Bcredit%2Band%2Bequities&a=corporate+credit+and+equities) , and[retirement solutions](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4790092-1&h=559885533&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.nexpoint.com%2Four-businesses%2Fretirement-solutions%2F&a=retirement+solutions) . NexPoint’s businesses span asset classes, industries, and strategies, providing the flexibility to invest across capital structures and market environments. Serving a diverse client base, NexPoint’s investment strategies are offered in a range of vehicles and fund structures, including mutual funds, public and private REITs, tax-advantaged vehicles, private funds, and separate accounts. For more information, including important risks and disclosures, visit nexpoint.com.
